verdict.rationale: A public status page with per-service history and post-incident reports is a fair question for a cloud provider, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an OCI status or health dashboard, incident history, or published post-incident reports. Community mentions of outages describe incidents, not a public status surface.

support.subject: As an operations lead, outages are owned in public — a real status/health surface with per-service history and post-incident reports
